title: Plumeform card grid (v2)
description: A dark band over a backdrop slot: an eyebrow and heavy heading (centred or left), a slate lead, an optional pill CTA with a short note beside it, then a three-column grid of frosted glass cards, each with a mint line icon or mint eyebrow, a bold title with an optional PLUS badge, and a short paragraph. The backdrop fades in as the band arrives; heading and cards rise and un-blur into view one after another.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); the backdrop is a placeholder until given a video or WebGL scene
three columns on desktop, one on phones
name: plumeform-v2-card-grid

props.name: cta
props.description: a pill button under the heading

props.description: a short line beside the button

props.name: backdrop
